examples.description: Canonical Hello World App with explicit IO.Print import and finalized output.
Launch two Apps, join in reverse order, show output in explicit source order.
Public paragraph scalars and project-owned vocabulary Dictionary.
Text declaration from the complete Hello World program.
Number declaration from the complete public-values example.
Sibling and enclosing source scopes preserve independent bindings.
Sequential Execute actions activate local continuations.
Scoped action and descriptor definitions reuse source vocabulary.
Intentional runtime error Exit stops later continuation and program actions.
Later invocation and retained scalar/output snapshots.
Continuation launches and awaits another App.
Intentional runtime failure: raw stdout contains the newline added by Print.
Project-owned member imports resolved relative to the importing file.
Companion vocabulary source for file-import, displayed as a source unit, not independently run.
Basic App with canonical IO.Print and explicit Run/Await/Output.
Compiler rejects Text as the operand of Await.
Compiler rejects an unresolved Await operand.
Exact structured registry for source lexicons and dictionary entries. This is resource configuration, not L source.
Complete nested Class and Object construction. TestFrontendRecursiveClassSource checks generated structure and native compilation, not execution.
Implicit Main adjective and its Function, Object, and Service construction rules, already loaded by the compiler.
Native-backed ProbeIO dictionary operation used by App bodies. This vocabulary fragment is not independently executable.
First descriptor from the complete interleaved-Class compilation witness. This excerpt is not independently executable.
Documentation-only combination of source-preparation shapes. This explains sentences and paragraphs without compilation or execution.
Documentation-only comment and literal example based on source scanning. It has not been compiled or executed.
Name declaration and App-body use from the complete basic demo. It requires its preceding IO import and later lifecycle instructions.
Documentation-only Text operands illustrating escaped backticks, literal backslash-n, Unicode, braces and interior markup. Evidence is static inspection, not execution.
Execution and explicit Output member read. It requires the basic demo declarations omitted from this excerpt.
Implicit Start/Execute source definitions and their declared verb inflections, already loaded by the compiler, not user redeclarations.
Canonical observer showing a numeric-looking declaration resolved as a Text binding. Numeric-resolution witnesses check the same source shape. Those witnesses were not run here.
Documentation-only App-body fragment drawn from the source-number parity witness. This fragment has no lifecycle instructions and has not been executed.
Complete LANG-13 program: Truth equality chooses Await and then reads finalized App output. Existing native witness, not run here.
Documentation-only public Print calls supplying Text, Number and Truth to the private native Thing parameter. This shows static composition and makes no execution claim.
App alias and scalar Output snapshot excerpt. It requires earlier App declaration and continuation. Full demo has existing native witnesses.
Documentation excerpt reproducing TestParagraphBindingNativeTypeForwardMemberShadowsOuter source. This provides binding and source-location evidence only, with no runtime-before-assignment claim.
First three declarations from the complete public-values runtime witness. The following Dictionary and Show statements are omitted.
Canonical LANG-06 pronoun, alias, repeated Await, and possessive Output program. Frontend identity checks and native expected bytes are retained witnesses.
Intentionally invalid N11 fixture: the new paragraph has no preceding pronoun subject. Compilation rejects it before publication.
Canonical Process, Function and Function.Return definitions shared by source bodies and Object construction.
Implicit Objective descriptor uses a grouped native word. The nested array is not an L collection literal.
Canonical IO.Print import line. The rest of the runnable basic program is omitted.
Complete LANG-14 caller includes its sibling continuation.l. Existing frontend and native witnesses preserve include order and caller-local snapshot ownership.
Companion source included by LANG-14. Snapshot belongs to the caller and this file is not independently executable.
Intentionally invalid explanatory fragment shortened from the IO02 private-helper regression. Write is unresolved. Static review only, not independently compiled.
Ordered lifecycle and display excerpt from the complete two-App CLI witness. It requires preceding First and Second declarations.
Snapshot and rerun excerpt from LANG-11. It requires the preceding Worker declaration and IO import.
Conditional ownership excerpt from the member-resolution frontend witness. The preceding App, x, and execution are omitted. No successful runtime claim.
Documentation-only unsupported While illustration derived from configured grammar and the explicit outer-instruction rejection. This fragment has not been parsed or run.
Bare Exit from an App continuation terminates later paragraph and program actions. This is a complete maintained runtime witness.
Primitive Build/Run/Await/Show excerpt from the App lifecycle witness. It omits the declaration and test-owned ProbeIO setup.
Stop/Await ordering excerpt. Worker and its Error-checking continuation are declared earlier. Existing native witness permits termination or normal-completion race outcomes.
Complete LANG-01 witness: Run launches, first Await activates the continuation inline, and cached Await does not repeat its effects.
Complete N07 runtime-negative source displayed as an explanatory fragment: Build creates no invocation, so Await fails at runtime. It is excluded from automatic example execution.
Canonical LANG-02 outer passive Await. The existing native witness expects passive followed by LF.
Canonical N09 rejection: active Await inside an App body is recognized but unsupported at executable-body lowering.
Left/Right Service descriptors and a Grouped App construction from the maintained workspace fixture. It requires the preceding IO.Print import and omits the second App.
Ordinary Functions compose Identity and Relay with an explicit caller result, then Show writes hello.
Identity declaration and Return from the complete composed-functions example.
Require constructs a runtime failure only in the absent Option branch.
Send composes a borrowed byte projection and one write_all operation.
Lined Sender wraps the retained base with source-defined Result selection.
Native-signature IO caller Functions with explicit writer and payload context. The documentation native witness supplies their host and checks exact bytes.
Option/Result selection, Require and Expect callers with native signatures and typed Process inputs. The documentation native witness uses actual Runtime support.
Native-signature Retain caller context. The documentation native witness checks Arc identity and shared ownership.
Source-owned List, Map, Pointer, Bytes, Null and Error uses with exact displayed values.
Focused list use from the complete word-values program. Omitted surrounding declarations remain available in the full source.
Focused map use from the complete word-values program. Omitted surrounding declarations remain available in the full source.
Focused pointer use from the complete word-values program. Omitted surrounding declarations remain available in the full source.
Focused bytes use from the complete word-values program. Omitted surrounding declarations remain available in the full source.
A declared Truth operand in a negated condition selects exactly the expected branch.
examples.validation: static-inspection; explicit example verification reported separately
